dict.Marchează zonele de păstrat / de elimina: Mark areas to keep / to remove…
dict.Cât de apropiate sunt culorile fundalulu: How close the background colors are
dict.Ce e acoperit cu mov dispare. Trage cu ＋: What is covered in purple disappears. Drag with ＋ over what should stay and with − over what should go (Shift switches the brush on the spot).
dict.Nu am găsit singur fundalul. Marchează-l: I couldn't find the background on my own. Mark it yourself with −.
dict.Pensula roșie: zona peste care tragi și: Red brush: the area you drag over and its connected color disappear
dict.Pensula verde: zona peste care tragi răm: Green brush: the area you drag over stays in the picture
